summary.cross_record_scope: explicit reference map + alternative identity + event chain continuity + supports-cycle checks
not_implemented: event_sha256 payload recomputation because canonical event payload is not yet specified
all state-machine transitions for every namespace
full polymorphic reference coverage for every field

limitations: directory_manifest.py implements a restricted FileEntry-only canonicalization profile for a proposed JCS-compatible subset; it is not a general RFC 8785 implementation.
No filesystem traversal, actual file-byte hashing, symlink resolution, or directory-manifest recomputation from a real tree was executed.
Event sequence/previous-hash continuity is checked, but event_sha256 payload recomputation is not implemented because canonical event payload is not specified.

Cross-record validation covers an explicit subset of references, alternate identity, project/type consistency, selected state transitions, event chain continuity and supports cycles; not every polymorphic field/reference is covered.
Migration prototype is v1.3-to-v1.4 staging only; no transactional commit or pointer-based rollback is implemented.
Migration test fixture intentionally contains ambiguous validation_ids; unresolved item is expected and blocks commit.
Physics/scientific acceptance, real HEP benchmark, FeynRules/UFO/Mathematica execution are not implemented or run.
All four decisions remain recommendations pending explicit approval; schema was not changed in this step.
Symlinks are rejected by the manifest-only helper; enabling symlinks requires a filesystem-aware verifier that proves resolved targets remain inside the root.

The state_transition_event schema currently does not expose a separate target record-type field for record_id; the validator checks unique ID resolution and emits a warning, but exact target type validation is incomplete.
